long long compute_cost(long long k, int idx, int bitmask) {
    if (k == 0) return 0;
    
    long long divisor = nrs[idx];
    long long remainder = k % divisor;
    if (remainder < 0) remainder += divisor;
    
    if (bitmask & 1) remainder -= divisor;
    
    long long diff = k - remainder;
    long long steps = llabs(diff) / divisor;
    long long cost = steps * (idx + 1);
    
    return cost + compute_cost(remainder, idx - 1, bitmask >> 1);
}
